final: WITH product_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT line_count * 1.0 / SUM(line_count) OVER () AS share FROM product_counts), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(pc.line_count) AS combined_count, AVG(ps.share) AS average_share, AVG(ps.share - oa.avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM product_counts pc JOIN product_shares ps ON ps.share = pc.line_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(line_count) FROM product_counts) CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ps.share > oa.avg_share
